hints.title: Assign Ungrouped Items Unique Groups
hints.text: Items without an assigned group should each receive a new distinct group identifier to avoid false grouping constraints.

hints.title: Construct Item and Group Dependency Graphs
hints.text: Build two separate directed acyclic graphs: one representing dependencies between items, and another between groups.

hints.title: Perform Two-Level Topological Ordering
hints.text: Topologically sort items and groups independently; return empty if either ordering encounters a directed cycle.

hints.title: See the blueprint

variables: V: total items n plus groups m
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Single-level topological ordering fails to maintain contiguous grouping of items.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Decomposing the hierarchy into item-level and group-level Kahn sorts ensures linear running time and correct grouping.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should recognize two-level topological sorting and properly isolate items with group = -1.
complexity.notes: If either graph contains a directed cycle, no valid sequence exists.
